summary: A 60km/h through road beside a park, but no cars park anywhere along this kerb.
reasons: No parked cars along the whole kerb
Through route, not a parking street
Park backs it, but that's moot

drivers.seclusion: The south side backs onto open parkland and tree canopy for the whole 163m, with the nearest houses 15–45m away and only right at the far ends.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed two-lane road with a painted edge line and a timber bollard fence between verge and park; no obvious lay-by or widened shoulder to pull into.
drivers.traffic: Tertiary road, 60km/h, lit, two lanes with a centreline — a through route rather than a quiet residential street.
drivers.convention: No vehicles are parked along this stretch in either image set, and OSM tags it parking:both=no — nothing suggests stopping here is normal.

flags: Steep in parts: grade reaches about 15.6% near the western end, though a flatter ~20m stretch exists mid-route
Busy 60km/h road could mean passing traffic noise overnight
sun_shade: Mostly shaded — mature park trees overhang the kerb from the south side for most of the length.
cannot_judge: Whether there's an actual no-stopping sign or line on site
Street lighting brightness at this specific spot
